title: On-call, escalation, MTTR and the blameless postmortem

videos.script: Somebody has to carry the pager. This lesson is about making that bearable, and about learning from the nights it rings. {{pager}} First the rota. Who is on call, for how long, and what happens when they do not answer. {{rota}} Then the numbers teams use to judge their response. Time to detect, time to acknowledge, time to restore. And why their averages mislead. {{numbers}} Then the postmortem of the incident from lesson 17. Written without blame, because blame teaches people to hide what they did, and hidden facts cannot be fixed. {{blameless}} It ends with the part most teams skip. Making sure the actions actually happen. {{actions}}
